how: Free validation probes: each endpoint was sent a body of deliberately wrong types, and its 422/400 answer named the fields it accepts. Nothing was generated or billed.

muapi.upload: POST https://api.muapi.ai/api/v1/upload_file (multipart `file`, header x-api-key) accepts mp4 and mp3 and returns {url: https://cdn.muapi.ai/...}
muapi.note: Only omni-reference takes audio. image-to-video (one keyframe, `image_url`) has no audio field.

runway.note: `audio` on this endpoint is a boolean (generate sound), not a reference.
